purpose: Train full-contact recovery without relying on unreachable late joint targets; retain necessary early head-pivot motion

shared.actor: Original official getup actor; fresh actor Adam; imported normalizer frozen
shared.critic: New common-interface admitted critic and its50-step Adam, same for both arms
shared.action_history: Selected raw network outputs; frozen interval zeros; never substitute processed targets
shared.environment_rewards: Original, identical in both arms; no head-HOME or standing switch

changed_factor.joints: All14 using source-model HOME and physical intervals
changed_factor.loss: Mean over eligible active samples of sum_j distance(HOME_j+actor_mean_j, [lower_j,upper_j]) squared
changed_factor.deployment: Auxiliary loss absent; actor interface remains61->14 with common target processor

selection.order: Control train50, control evaluation, fresh same-condition official evaluation, then review; candidate only if control lacks motion gates with adequate release coverage
selection.simplest_passing_control: Select as a development lead and skip candidate; independent confirmation still required
selection.candidate: All original and final-hold group gates, plus at least2more final-hold successes than failed matched control
selection.feasibility: Before candidate budget, check control final_successes+2<=320; coverage or numerical/interface failures close the line
selection.secondary_metrics: Per-joint requested-range excess, real contacts and actual support; never substitute them for motion gates

stops.phase_watch: Freeze a whole-world late kinematic decline rule using the new value dataset before training
stops.kl: Same policy KL gates in both arms, including auxiliary updates
stops.budget: No automatic retry, continuation or extension
stops.video: Full8s training episodes from boundaries; complete11s evaluations; partial footage explicit; no added physics

remaining_before_freeze: Implement visible training/collection/coordinator and independent trace checks
Check actual initial actor/critic/optimizers/RNG equality, resets and post5s requests before physics
Freeze complete source/model/data hashes, watch threshold and reachable continuation logic
